title: IT guy fixes frozen infotainment
hook: Have you tried turning it off and on again? 🚗💻
caption:
10 years in IT and my most-used skill still works on cars 😂

In-car touchscreens run software, and software sometimes hangs. Let's be honest: we've all been there with a frozen screen or a phone that won't connect.

Tip: before you panic, check your car's manual for the proper way to restart the infotainment system. Many cars have a specific method, and it varies by brand.

Tag your IT friend who fixes everything with a restart 👇
